# crosswork_trap_destination (Resource)

This resource can manage a trap receiver for the notification destinations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_trap_destination" "example" {
  name                 = "cwtest-trap"
  address              = "192.0.2.30"
  address_type         = "IPADDRESS"
  port                 = 162
  transport_type       = "UDP"
  snmp_version         = "VERSION_2C"
  community_wo         = "cwtest-community"
  community_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) IP address or host name of the receiver
- `name` (String) Name of the receiver. A receiver whose address is a host name takes the host name as its name

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `address_type` (String) Whether the address is an IP address or a host name
  - Choices: `IPADDRESS`, `DNS`
  - Default value: `IPADDRESS`
- `auth_password` (String, Sensitive) SNMP v3 authentication password
  - Only one of `auth_password` and `auth_password_wo` can be set.
  - This attribute stores the secret in Terraform state. Prefer `auth_password_wo` together with `auth_password_wo_version`, which keeps it out of state.
- `auth_password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) SNMP v3 authentication password
  - Only one of `auth_password` and `auth_password_wo` can be set.
- `auth_password_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for `auth_password_wo`. Increment this integer whenever the write-only value changes so Terraform sends the new secret. The value is stored in state; the secret is not.
- `auth_type` (String) SNMP v3 authentication type
  - Choices: `HMACMD5`, `HMACSHA`
- `community` (String, Sensitive) SNMP v2c community
  - Only one of `community` and `community_wo` can be set.
  - This attribute stores the secret in Terraform state. Prefer `community_wo` together with `community_wo_version`, which keeps it out of state.
- `community_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) SNMP v2c community
  - Only one of `community` and `community_wo` can be set.
- `community_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for `community_wo`. Increment this integer whenever the write-only value changes so Terraform sends the new secret. The value is stored in state; the secret is not.
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `mode` (String) SNMP v3 security mode
  - Choices: `AuthPriv`, `AuthNoPriv`, `NoAuthNoPriv`
- `port` (Number) Port of the receiver
  - Range: `100`-`65535`
  - Default value: `162`
- `privacy_password` (String, Sensitive) SNMP v3 privacy password
  - Only one of `privacy_password` and `privacy_password_wo` can be set.
  - This attribute stores the secret in Terraform state. Prefer `privacy_password_wo` together with `privacy_password_wo_version`, which keeps it out of state.
- `privacy_password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) SNMP v3 privacy password
  - Only one of `privacy_password` and `privacy_password_wo` can be set.
- `privacy_password_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for `privacy_password_wo`. Increment this integer whenever the write-only value changes so Terraform sends the new secret. The value is stored in state; the secret is not.
- `privacy_type` (String) SNMP v3 privacy type. `NONE` is for the mode `AuthNoPriv` and is refused with `AuthPriv`
  - Choices: `NONE`, `DES`, `AES128`, `AES192`, `AES256`, `CiscoAES192`, `CiscoAES256`
- `snmp_version` (String) SNMP version
  - Choices: `VERSION_2C`, `VERSION_3`
  - Default value: `VERSION_2C`
- `transport_type` (String) Transport protocol
  - Choices: `UDP`, `TCP`
  - Default value: `UDP`
- `username` (String) SNMP v3 user name

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_trap_destination.example "<name>"
```
